title: Mawak language
text: Mawak is an endangered Papuan language of the Trans–New Guinea phylum, spoken exclusively in Madang Province, Papua New Guinea, and classified within the Northern Adelbert Range subgroup of the Madang–Adelbert Range sub-phylum.
